newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity opens institutional office in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity opens institutional office in Argentina.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Friday its institutional services unit opened a sales office in Buenos Aires as a first step in its planned expansion throughout South America.
The office, to be staffed by one or two people, will market financial products and services to banks and brokers in the region, spokesman Andy Trincia told Reuters.
"At this point we are focusing on Argentina. But we are exploring other key markets in South America," Trincia said. "This is the beginning of our expansion in the region."
The institutional services unit will likely open more offices in South American capitals in the next year or two, he said.
Trincia said the offices will not market Fidelity's retail mutual funds or serve the broad public.
"At this point we are really focusing on the institutional business there," he said.
